stories.title: Four NFL quarterbacks in Year 2 and where they need to improve: Solak on Ward, Dart, Shough and Sanders
stories.summary: Cam Ward, Jaxson Dart, Tyler Shough and Shedeur Sanders are entering Year 2 in the NFL. Let's find one spot where each sophomore QB must get better in 2026.

stories.title: Mayfield felt 'disrespected' by Bucs' deal offers
stories.summary: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield said Thursday that he felt "disrespected a little bit" that he and the team could not reach an agreement on a new contract before his imposed deadline of the start of training camp.

stories.title: Cignetti: Big Ten proven No. 1, not 'hype machine'
stories.summary: Indiana coach Curt Cignetti, armed with statistical evidence, said the Big Ten doesn't "run a hype machine" and is "the best league in football."

stories.title: Police: Romo had open bottle of alcohol in car
stories.summary: CBS NFL analyst and former Cowboys quarterback Tony Romo had an open container of alcohol in his vehicle when he was arrested last week on suspicion of driving under the influence, police say.

stories.title: Collector pulls 1-of-1 Ohtani card, sells for $10M+
stories.summary: A memorabilia collector in Florida pulled a 1-of-1 Shohei Ohtani Dual Gold Logoman autographed card and proceeded to sell it for more than $10 million, according to the buyer.
